spec.description: Live monitoring dashboard for the VISTA C++ sensor-processing application. Data is received through Grafana Live channels published by grafana_bridge.

options.content: This dashboard listens to Grafana Live channels under `stream/${namespace}/...`. The C++ `grafana_bridge` worker will publish one measurement per data domain: `pointcloud`, `radar_targets`, `detected_objects`, `tracked_objects`, and `system_health`. Point-cloud panels intentionally display operational summaries rather than transmitting every XYZ point to Grafana. Change the **Namespace** variable above only when `GrafanaNamespace` in `DeviceConfig.txt` is changed.
